description: For a payment prepared with private: true, give the deposit_address from its quote_proof. Returns the NEAR Intents status: PENDING_DEPOSIT, KNOWN_DEPOSIT_TX, PROCESSING, SUCCESS, REFUNDED, INCOMPLETE_DEPOSIT or FAILED, with the reason when it cannot be read. Read-only, free, no key.

deposit_address.description: The deposit_address from the payment's quote_proof (prepare_payment with private: true).
